title: Last Lantern Tavern
subtitle: Rain at the crossroads. A room full of people pretending not to listen.
defaultPlayerAction: I ask who remembers the old north road.
openingNarration: The Last Lantern smells of wet wool, hot onions, and lamp oil. Somewhere beyond the shuttered windows, the old north road waits in the rain.
suggestedPlayerIntents: I ask who remembers the old north road.
Ask Mara what the Ashford name means.
Watch the room for who reacts to Mara's warning.

world.name: Last Lantern
world.premise: A rain-soaked crossroads tavern where travelers trade rumors before the old roads.

characters.name: Mara Underbough
characters.knowledgeBoundary: Knows local rumors and visible tavern history, not author-only hidden truth.

responses.narration: Mara Underbough pauses with one hand on a blue chipped bowl, warm enough to keep serving and watchful enough to notice who stops breathing. "The old north road remembers debts better than people do," she says. Around the Last Lantern, talk thins to rain on shutters. "Ashford is a lead, not an answer. For the next thread, ask after the north stones, but spend that name softly and choose who hears it."
nextChoices: Ask Mara what the Ashford name means.
Ask what debt the old north road remembers.
Watch the room for who reacts to Mara's warning.

responses.narration: Mara Underbough does not look toward the door when you say Ashford, which somehow makes the whole room look there for her. "Old family, older promise," she says. "The north stones mark where that promise broke. If you mean to tug that thread, do it after closing, and do not let the red-scarfed drover hear you ask."
nextChoices: Ask which promise broke at the north stones.
Wait until closing to ask Mara privately.
Watch the red-scarfed drover without making it obvious.

responses.narration: Mara Underbough studies you from behind the tavern bar. "Start with what road brought you here," she says, "and I will tell you which names the Last Lantern still remembers."
nextChoices: I ask who remembers the old north road.
Ask who last came in from the rain.
Look for the quietest table in the room.
